nordvpn.name: NordVPN
nordvpn.blurb: Audited no-logs VPN for public Wi-Fi and untrusted networks. It encrypts traffic in transit; it does not stop phishing or malware.

nordpass.name: NordPass
nordpass.blurb: Zero-knowledge password manager with breach monitoring and passkey support. Pair it with MFA; it is step one, not the whole plan.

sucuri.name: Sucuri
sucuri.blurb: Cloud WAF, malware scanning, and hacked-site cleanup for CMS-run websites. A filter in front of your site, not a substitute for patching.

surfshark.name: Surfshark
surfshark.blurb: Budget VPN with unlimited devices on one subscription. Same honest caveat as any VPN: it protects traffic in transit, not against malware or phishing.

amazon-yubikey.name: YubiKey 5C NFC
amazon-yubikey.blurb: Hardware security key supporting FIDO2, U2F, TOTP, and passkeys. Phishing-resistant in a way app codes are not, but buy two; losing your only key locks you out.

amazon-cissp-guide.name: ISC2 CISSP Official Study Guide
amazon-cissp-guide.blurb: The Sybex official text most candidates structure their prep around. No book substitutes for the five years of experience ISC2 requires, but this is the standard one.

amazon-ceh-guide.name: CEH v13 Study Guide
amazon-ceh-guide.blurb: Sybex guide matched to the current CEH exam version. Pair it with hands-on lab time; reading alone will not build the skills the exam or the job expects.

amazon-cism-guide.name: CISM All-in-One Exam Guide
amazon-cism-guide.blurb: The standard text for ISACA's management-track cert. Best for engineers moving toward security leadership; it teaches governance, not hands-on defense.

proton-mail.name: Proton Mail
proton-mail.blurb: Encrypted email from Switzerland with PGP built in, no key wrangling required. End-to-end encryption only applies Proton-to-Proton or with PGP contacts; mail to ordinary inboxes travels like ordinary email.

proton-pass.name: Proton Pass
proton-pass.blurb: Open-source password manager from the Proton team with a built-in TOTP authenticator and email aliases. Storing codes beside passwords trades some separation of factors for convenience; know that tradeoff.
